main.description: The contact email and maintenance setting in each preferences space named, for HappyProto's provisioner, which emails owners about maintenance. Only the provisioner may call it, with a service-auth token; everyone else is refused.

spaces.description: Preferences space uris (at.happyproto.preferences, key self), 1 to 50. Repeats are answered once.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not the provisioner, or the provisioner's DID is not configured.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: spaces is missing, has more than 50 entries, or names something that is not a preferences space.

status.description: ok: read. missing: no such preferences space. unreadable: it could not be read just now; ask again later.

creator.description: The account that owns the space. Present when status is ok.

email.description: The contact email in use. Absent when there is none. Never the pending address. Whether it is confirmed is the provisioner's to check.

maintenance.description: Whether the owner wants maintenance emails. True unless they turned them off. Present when status is ok.
